scope: Installed-wheel official main server; genuine Core ML, alignment and diarization.
limitations: Fixed official fixtures, not a corpus-quality or throughput benchmark.
Each preset uses its own process and engine-scoped environment configuration.
No server pool, readiness endpoint, or engine-close contract is assumed.
Cancellation is cooperative at prediction boundaries.

params-schema.description: Per-request decoding budget; omitted values use the engine's defaults.

config-schema.description: Standard ASR cache defaults, with explicit paths for existing local bundles.

allow_private_urls.description: Opt-in to relax the SSRF policy so an AudioUrl may target a private/loopback/link-local address (HTTPS is still required). False by default; set True only for a trusted internal endpoint.
allow_private_urls.title: Allow Private Urls

download_root.title: Download Root

model_dir.title: Model Dir

source_dir.title: Source Dir

use_draft.description: Enable the optional GPU draft using its managed cache path.

draft_dir.title: Draft Dir

draft_bits.description: In-memory quantization of the draft decoder; None keeps bf16.

use_diarization.description: Enable explicitly acquired speaker diarization on the CPU.
